Marta (Design): Quick check on a small but important flow: when users click Copy on the one-time token reveal, we should show a subtle confirmation that the value was copied and keep the token visible for 6s. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/newtokens/one-time-copy. Thoughts? Ethan (Frontend): Implementation note: navigator.clipboard.writeText is straightforward but we need a fallback for older browsers. We'll show a tooltip "Copied!" and emit analytics event token.copy. Also agree to keep token visible briefly, but avoid keeping it longer than necessary (6s ok). Rhea (A11y): For screen readers, do not rely on visual tooltip. Add a polite aria-live region that announces: "Token copied to clipboard. This value will not be shown again." Also ensure focus remains predictable (don't move focus away from the Copy button). Example:
Token copied to clipboard...
. Omar (Security): Fine with 6s visibility. Add requirement: once copied, mark the token in audit logs with `copied=true`. Also deny copy for tokens flagged as sensitive by policy (return 403 and show inline error). Lina (PM): UX: confirm copy microcopy should be exactly: "Copied to clipboard. This token will not be shown again." CTA after copy: none. But in the reveal flow we should show a small permanent hint: "Save this now. You won't be able to view it later." Jon (QA): I'll add tests for clipboard behavior: 1) ensure aria-live fires, 2) fallback pasteable input exists if clipboard API fails, 3) 6s hide timer. Also test copy blocked by policy returns visible error. Marta (Design): One more: for Rotate, mirror the same behavior (reveal + copy + aria-live + audit flag). For Revoke undo, we keep snackbar undo 10s and ensure it is reachable via keyboard (focusable Undo button). Ethan (Frontend): Will prototype in storybook and include keyboard + SR tests. I'll also add a small shield icon next to tokens with admin scopes so it's not color-only. Rhea (A11y): Add sr-only text for the shield: "High privilege token". And ensure tooltip content is keyboard accessible. Lina (PM): Thanks everyone. Marta, can you update Figma with the exact copy and the aria-live notes? I'll file tickets for analytics (token.copy), audit flag, and policy block behavior. Marta (Design): On it 60a
